title: eludite.nuget.consolidate input
description: Consolidate a package installed at different versions across projects (Consolidate's Install). The project files (or Directory.Packages.props under Central Package Management) are edited with their formatting kept, then restored unless the setting nuget.restoreOnChange is off; a failed restore leaves the edit, with its errors in the answer and the Error List. Class execute under the solution policy's `nuget.change` (agents are asked by default). Every change is audited with the project, the package and the version.

version.description: The version to settle on (default: the highest installed).
